headline: Senior iOS & Mobile Architect | Full-Stack Engineer | Founder @ 11Hopem Software
summary: Senior Mobile Architect and Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of engineering excellence. Founder & CEO of 11Hopem Software (11hopem.com). Shipped mission-critical Swift applications across banking, fintech, IoT, and nationwide public-sector systems reaching millions of users — including İşCep (2M+ reviews, 4.6★), HomeWhiz (1M+ connected IoT hardware devices via MQTT), and DOA (T.C. Çevre Bakanlığı nationwide public recycling & KYC). Expert in building production-grade Next.js, React, and Python platforms with zero-crash guarantee, bank-grade security, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Selçuk University Computer Science graduate.

education.notes: Graduated with 3.19 GPA. Completed an intensive 1-year iOS software development internship. Worked as a professional technical translator (English - Turkish). Active participant and awardee in national hackathons and developer bootcamps.

backend_cloud_databases: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, RLS, Edge Functions, Storage)

experiences.summary: Directing architecture, product engineering, and AI automation across high-throughput web and mobile platforms.
highlights: Architected and deployed 15+ live SaaS and web platforms for enterprise and boutique clients.
Engineered FitQueen Club IoT smart turnstile access control with real-time membership verification.
Maintained 99.99% uptime across production platforms with strict zero-crash SLAs and automated CI/CD.

experiences.summary: Engineering Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) and mobile infrastructure for public infrastructure.
highlights: Architected scalable mobile infrastructure for smart transportation and field operations (KGM AUS).
Led technical analysis for Ankara Metropolitan Municipality (ABB DDKS IP-3) smart intersection systems.

experiences.summary: Core engineer on DOA (T.C. Çevre Bakanlığı / TÜÇA), Turkey's largest nationwide public deposit refund & fintech platform.
highlights: Architected biometric face KYC verification, NFC smart card hardware integrations, and payout modules for millions of users.
Delivered fluid 60fps UI using advanced UICollectionView Compositional Layouts and Combine pipelines.
Performed technical code audits on national transport frameworks (UTTS, Fuel and Win, Rotta Frameworks).

experiences.summary: Core engineer on HomeWhiz, an enterprise smart home IoT ecosystem managing millions of connected appliances.
highlights: Delivered sub-100ms real-time appliance control using the MQTT protocol and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
Elevated code quality across high-complexity Swift tasks, established unit testing suites, and drove Agile transformation.

experiences.summary: Engineered mobile banking, factoring, investment, and healthtech platforms across the İşbank ecosystem.
highlights: Developed core native modules for İşCep, serving millions of daily active users with 2M+ reviews and 4.6★ rating.
Built localized native banking applications for international branches (UK London, Georgia, Iraq, Kosovo).
Architected QR check scanning and inter-bank financial bidding for İş Faktoring and Fiba Faktoring.
Integrated NFC e-ID reading and WebRTC video call customer acquisition (Video KYC) for İş Yatırım & Ünlü & Co.
Engineered Triwi mobile health platform with Apple HealthKit and wearable sensor integrations.
Conducted technical code audits for Nays, Lunafi, Bayındır Sağlık, Paşabahçe, ProEmtia, and İş Leasing.
